name: MomOS
author: MomOS
description: Shows whether a MomOS laptop is online, asking for help, or being worked on by an agent. The panel has the latest screenshot and buttons to view the screen, start an investigation, approve a fix, or send a message to the screen. Needs the MomOS dispatcher running on this machine.

barWidget.description: The person's laptop at a glance, through the MomOS dispatcher.
